conditions.order: alternating before/after frontend, rotating before/after/clang lowering
conditions.frontend_timer: frontend_total excludes input reading, process startup and IR output; includes tokenize, parse, generation and AST/token teardown
conditions.lowering_timer: process wall time includes Clang startup, IR reading, backend and object write
conditions.clang_ir: Previous snapshot: same preprocessed bytes, Clang -x cpp-output -std=gnu99 -O0 -g0 -S -emit-llvm
conditions.intrinsics: Nine unconditional LLVM intrinsic declarations are retained; pruning these is outside this change.

change: LLVM function declarations, including reserved libc functions, are emitted only when referenced by retained definitions or global initializers. Existing ABI diagnostics and definition retention are preserved.

clean_builds.conditions: Same flags, jobs=4, source revisions and alternating Dynamite/Clang order as the original snapshot; two clean runs each, warm/not-cleared filesystem caches. This follow-up is not an interleaved comparison with the old compiler.

runtime_validation.git: Both compilers: version, init, config, add, commit, clean status, log, switch, diff, gc, fsck. GIT_EXEC_PATH points to each build directory.
runtime_validation.redis: Both compilers: PING, SET/GET, exact x87 INCRBYFLOAT, HINCRBYFLOAT, Lua EVAL/cjson, SAVE, shutdown and RDB reload.
